title: Which Train Should We Take Now?
transcript:
Jade: I'm at the ticket hall. Are you waiting on platform six?
Owen: No. The announcement has changed our platform to eight. I'm standing beside the stairs.
Jade: Is our express train still leaving at ten thirty?
Owen: It is running fifteen minutes late. The display now says ten forty-five.
Jade: Did the announcement explain the delay?
Owen: Yes. Staff are checking a signal beside the track near North Junction. They cannot say when it will be ready.
Jade: I don't want to cancel our journey, but we will miss our connection at North Junction. Shall we use a direct service instead?
Owen: Yes. The conductor says the eleven o'clock service goes directly to the coast. We won't need a transfer.
Jade: Is our ticket valid on that service?
Owen: Yes, but our seat reservation is not. We can ask for new seats at the desk.
Jade: I'd like a seat near the luggage space. This suitcase is heavy.
Owen: There are two seats together in carriage five. The fare is the same, so we don't need to pay extra.
Jade: Good. What is the new arrival time?
Owen: Twelve ten. I'll message our friend now. She is meeting us outside the station.
Jade: What if she gets there early?
Owen: The terminal has an indoor waiting room. She can wait there and come outside when our train arrives.
Jade: Thanks. I'm buying some water before we board. Do you want anything?
Owen: Just water. Please meet me by the stairs at ten fifty. We should allow ten minutes to get to the right carriage.
Jade: All right. I'll check the platform display again before I come.
